description:
Adds farm animals.

Add new animal inhabitants to your worlds!  These can be tamed, renamed and bred.  Also includes food and other items.

- Bee (1 variant)
- Chicken (3 variants)
- Cows (2 variants)
- Kitten (5 variants)
- Panda (1 variant)
- Penguin (1 variant)
- Rabbit (4 variants)
- Rat (4 variants)
- Sheep (16 variants)
- Warthog (1 variant)
